policy.migration_rule: Migrate one real role at a time behind a reversible server-owned route. A legacy DeepSeek receipt must never be relabelled as Qwen.
policy.student_ui_policy: Do not expose provider, model, endpoint, prompt, reasoning or billing identity. Preserve all of them in restricted audit records.
policy.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is immutable, reserved for reconciliation and never replayed with a new operation identity.

roles.notes: Private-course source parsing, semantic consolidation and <=50-node tree generation remain the sole DeepSeek exception.
R1 first improves the existing safe stream without changing the model; R5 owns the later scoped migration.
Plan is private and may not cross the student public-event boundary.
Only display content and citations may be streamed publicly.
This is the first proposed low-coupling Qwen migration role after stable streaming.
question_author.py currently accepts only a verified DeepSeek receipt or labelled fixture. Repair the provider identity contract without weakening question content validation.
blind_solve.py has the same DeepSeek-or-labelled-fixture restriction.
The reviewer contract and qualification lineage require an explicit Qwen-compatible identity path.
Uses the existing Question Engine and server-owned source, point, operation, rubric and ledger identities.
Deterministic grading authority remains server-side; an LLM may only supply the permitted semantic explanation.
Call-site enumeration and an isolated receipt are still required before migration.
The Agent service is configured for Qwen, but current evidence does not prove that each student call site traverses it.
Embedding and deterministic retrieval are not general LLM roles.
It may provide a qualified signal but does not become a universal synchronous gate.

open_gates: Enumerate all live call sites and bind each to one listed role.
Add an explicit Qwen receipt identity accepted by author, blind-solver and reviewer contracts without accepting arbitrary client labels.
Run authorized per-role capability and business-path evidence before switching any user scope.
Keep the DeepSeek route online as a truthful rollback until each Qwen role is accepted.
Remove model labels only from system UI; do not alter user content or restricted audit records.
